title: Upgraded Rocket launcher for NPC ONLY FE credits by DuaKNo
script:
--[[
	CLASSIC ROCKET LAUNCHER - Client-only (Explosion visual kept, engine kill disabled)
]]

--========================================================
-- SIMULATION RADIUS BOOST
--========================================================
local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

local function boostRadius()
	pcall(function() sethiddenproperty(LocalPlayer, "SimulationRadius", 5000) end)
	pcall(function() setsimulationradius(5000, 5000) end)
end

boostRadius()

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(2)
		boostRadius()
	end
end)

--========================================================
-- ROCKET LAUNCHER
--========================================================
local function runDummyScript(f, scri)
	local oldenv = getfenv(f)
	local newenv = setmetatable({}, {
		__index = function(_, k)
			if k:lower() == 'script' then return scri else return oldenv[k] end
		end
	})
	setfenv(f, newenv)
	ypcall(function() f() end)
end

local cors = {}

local mas = Instance.new("Model", game:GetService("Lighting"))
mas.Name = "CompiledModel"

local Tool          = Instance.new("Tool")
local Handle        = Instance.new("Part")
local Mesh          = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
local ReloadSound   = Instance.new("Sound")
local ToolScript    = Instance.new("LocalScript")
local MouseIcon     = Instance.new("LocalScript")
local ShuHold       = Instance.new("Script")

Tool.Name = "Rocket Launcher"
Tool.Parent = mas
Tool.TextureId = ""
Tool.Grip = CFrame.new(0.9, -0.01, -0.4) * CFrame.fromOrientation(0, math.rad(-90), math.rad(-90))
Tool.CanBeDropped = false

Handle.Name = "Handle"
Handle.Parent = Tool
Handle.Position = Vector3.new(787.34, 3.70, 228.68)
Handle.Rotation = Vector3.new(-180, 0, -180)
Handle.CanCollide = false
Handle.FormFactor = Enum.FormFactor.Custom
Handle.Size = Vector3.new(5, 1, 1)
Handle.CFrame = CFrame.new(787.34, 3.70, 228.68, -1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, -1)
Handle.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
Handle.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth

Mesh.Parent = Handle
Mesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://12221651"
Mesh.TextureId = "rbxassetid://12224070"
Mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
Mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh

ReloadSound.Name = "Reload"
ReloadSound.Parent = Handle
ReloadSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://5801258866"
ReloadSound.Volume = 1.2
ReloadSound.Pitch = 0.9
ReloadSound.RollOffMaxDistance = 250
ReloadSound.RollOffMinDistance = 5
ReloadSound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered

ToolScript.Name = "ToolScript"
ToolScript.Parent = Tool
table.insert(cors, coroutine.create(function()
	wait()
	runDummyScript(function()
		local SHOT_SPEED = 180
		local SHOT_TIME  = 10
		local MUZZLE_LOCAL_OFFSET = Vector3.new(2.2, 0, 0)
		local EXPLOSION_RADIUS = 12
		local EXPLOSION_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://12221984"

		local ROCKET_FORWARD_OFFSET = 1.5
		local MAX_CLICK_RANGE = 500

		local ROCKET_MESH_ID = "rbxassetid://2251534"
		local ROCKET_MESH_SCALE = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
		local ROCKET_COLOR = "Medium stone grey"
		local ROCKET_FIRE_HEAT = 4
		local ROCKET_FIRE_SIZE = 2

		local ROCKET_INITIAL_ARC   = 0.45
		local ROCKET_STEER_P       = 2500
		local ROCKET_STEER_D       = 250
		local ROCKET_DETONATE_DIST = 3.0
		local ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST  = 25
		local ROCKET_ARC_FULL_DIST = 90
		local ROCKET_ARM_TIME      = 0.15

		local ROCKET_SLOWDOWN_DIST = 25
		local ROCKET_MIN_SPEED_FRACTION = 0.35
		local ROCKET_CORNER_MIN_SPEED = 0.35

		local WHOOSH_START_VOLUME = 2
		local WHOOSH_FADE_START   = 15
		local WHOOSH_FADE_END     = 220

		-- === OBSTACLE AVOIDANCE ===
		local ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD   = 100
		local ROCKET_OBSTACLE_AVOID_PULL  = 3.2
		local ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND          = 0.85
		local ROCKET_AVOID_STICKY_TIME    = 0.60
		local ROCKET_AVOID_RAMP_EXP       = 0.45

		local ROCKET_MAX_LEAD_TIME = 0.75
		local ROCKET_MIN_LEAD_SPEED = 2

		local ROCKET_TERMINAL_LOCK_DIST = 30
		local ROCKET_OVERSHOOT_DIST = 12

		-- === EXPLOSION TUNING ===
		local EXPLOSION_BLAST_PRESSURE   = 0     -- Keeps explosion visual & instance active, but strips out default engine kill force
		local BLAST_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH   = 250   
		local NPC_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH     = 110   

		local PlayersService     = Game:GetService('Players')
		local DebrisService      = Game:GetService('Debris')
		local RunService         = Game:GetService('RunService')
		local SoundService       = Game:GetService('SoundService')
		local UserInputService   = Game:GetService('UserInputService')

		local Workspace = workspace
		local LocalPlayer = PlayersService.LocalPlayer

		local Tool = script.Parent
		local Handle = Tool:WaitForChild('Handle')
		local ReloadSound = Handle:WaitForChild('Reload')

		local Character, Humanoid, Player = nil, nil, nil
		local BaseShot = nil

		local ActiveShot     = nil
		local ActiveWhoosh   = nil
		local ActiveUpdateConn = nil

		local function cleanupActive()
			if ActiveUpdateConn then
				ActiveUpdateConn:Disconnect()
				ActiveUpdateConn = nil
			end
			if ActiveWhoosh then
				ActiveWhoosh:Stop()
				ActiveWhoosh:Destroy()
				ActiveWhoosh = nil
			end
			if ActiveShot then
				ActiveShot = nil
			end
		end

		local function playAtPosition(soundId, position, volume, pitch)
			local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
			anchor.Anchored = true
			anchor.CanCollide = false
			anchor.Transparency = 1
			anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
			anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
			anchor.Parent = Workspace

			local s = Instance.new("Sound")
			s.SoundId = soundId
			s.Volume = volume or 2
			s.Pitch = pitch or 1
			s.RollOffMaxDistance = 500
			s.RollOffMinDistance = 5
			s.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
			s.Parent = anchor

			s:Play()
			DebrisService:AddItem(anchor, 5)
		end

		local function WeOwnCharacter(character)
			if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				or character.PrimaryPart
			if not root then return false end
			local owner = nil
			pcall(function() owner = root:GetNetworkOwner() end)
			return owner == LocalPlayer
		end

		local function TryTakeOwnership(character)
			if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
			local gotAny = false
			for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					local ok = pcall(function()
						part:SetNetworkOwner(LocalPlayer)
					end)
					if ok then gotAny = true end
				end
			end
			return gotAny
		end

		local function ApplyDamageStack(humanoid, damage)
			if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then return end
			if damage and damage > 0 then
				pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(damage) end)
			end
			if not damage then
				pcall(function() humanoid.Health = -1 end)
				pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(9999999999) end)
			elseif humanoid.Health > 0 and damage >= 9999999 then
				pcall(function() humanoid.Health = -1 end)
				pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(9999999999) end)
			end
		end

		local function ReliableKill(character, humanoid)
			task.spawn(function()
				ApplyDamageStack(humanoid)

				if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

				for _ = 1, 20 do
					if not character.Parent or not humanoid.Parent then return end
					if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

					if not WeOwnCharacter(character) then
						TryTakeOwnership(character)
					end
					ApplyDamageStack(humanoid)
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			end)
		end

		local EXPLOSION_DAMAGE_BANDS = {
			{0.50, 9999999},
			{0.58, 0.90},
			{0.67, 0.70},
			{0.75, 0.50},
			{0.83, 0.35},
			{0.92, 0.20},
			{1.00, 0.10},
		}

		local function damageFractionForRatio(ratio)
			for _, band in ipairs(EXPLOSION_DAMAGE_BANDS) do
				if ratio <= band[1] then
					return band[2]
				end
			end
			return 0
		end

		local function isPlayerCharacter(char)
			if not char then return false end
			local ok, plr = pcall(function()
				return PlayersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
			end)
			return ok and plr ~= nil
		end

		local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
		overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {}

		local function applyExplosion(pos)
			local radius   = EXPLOSION_RADIUS
			local propKb   = BLAST_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH
			local npcKb    = NPC_KNOCKBACK_STRENGTH

			local parts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(pos, radius, overlapParams)
			local seenChars = {}

			for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
				local char = nil
				local node = part
				for _ = 1, 4 do
					if not node or node == Workspace then break end
					node = node.Parent
					if node and node:IsA("Model")
						and node:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						char = node
						break
					end
				end

				if char then
					if not seenChars[char] then
						seenChars[char] = true

						local hum  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						if hum and root and hum.Health > 0
							and char ~= Character
							and not isPlayerCharacter(char) then

							local d = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude
							if d <= radius then

								if not root.Anchored then
									local delta = root.Position - pos
									local dir
									if delta.Magnitude < 0.01 then
										dir = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
									else
										dir = delta.Unit
									end
									dir = (dir + Vector3.new(0, 0.55, 0)).Unit

									local falloff = 1 - (d / radius)
									local mass = root:GetMass()
									local impulse = dir * (npcKb * falloff) * mass

									pcall(function()
										root:ApplyImpulse(impulse)
									end)
								end

								local frac = damageFractionForRatio(d / radius)

								if frac > 1 then
									ReliableKill(char, hum)
								else
									local damage =
										(hum.MaxHealth > 0 and hum.MaxHealth or 100) * frac

									task.spawn(function()
										if not WeOwnCharacter(char) then
											for _ = 1, 5 do
												if not char.Parent or not hum.Parent
													or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
												TryTakeOwnership(char)
												if WeOwnCharacter(char) then break end
												task.wait(0.05)
											end
										end

										if not char.Parent or not hum.Parent then return end
										if hum.Health <= 0 then return end

										ApplyDamageStack(hum, damage)
									end)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and not part.Anchored then
					local delta = part.Position - pos
					local d = delta.Magnitude
					if d <= radius and d > 0.01 then
						local falloff = 1 - (d / radius)
						local mass = part:GetMass()
						local impulse = delta.Unit * (propKb * falloff) * mass
						pcall(function() part:ApplyImpulse(impulse) end)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local function killSounds(part)
			if not part then return end
			for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Sound") then
					child.Looped = false
					child:Stop()
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end

		local shotTargets = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

		local function OnTouched(shot, otherPart, detonatePosition)
			if not shot or not shot.Parent then return end
			if shot:GetAttribute("Hit") then return end

			if otherPart then
				if not shot:GetAttribute("Armed") then
					local tgt = shotTargets[shot]
					if not (tgt and otherPart:IsDescendantOf(tgt)) then
						return
					end
				end
				local allowSelf = shot:GetAttribute("AllowSelfHit") == true
				if (not allowSelf) and Character and otherPart:IsDescendantOf(Character) then
					return
				end
			end

			shot:SetAttribute("Hit", true)

			local pos = detonatePosition or shot.Position

			cleanupActive()
			killSounds(shot)
			shot:Destroy()

			-- Spawns the standard visual explosion object, but with 0 blast pressure so your custom damage bands handle the kills safely
			local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
			explosion.BlastRadius = EXPLOSION_RADIUS
			explosion.BlastPressure = EXPLOSION_BLAST_PRESSURE
			explosion.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
			explosion.Position = pos
			explosion.Parent = Workspace

			applyExplosion(pos)

			playAtPosition(EXPLOSION_SOUND_ID, pos, 2.5, 1)
		end

		local function OnEquipped()
			Character = Tool.Parent
			Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild('Humanoid')
			Player = PlayersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
		end

		local function nozzleCFrame(position, forward)
			forward = forward.Magnitude > 1e-4 and forward.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)

			local upRef = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			if math.abs(forward:Dot(upRef)) > 0.99 then
				upRef = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end

			local vZ = -forward
			local vY = (upRef - vZ * vZ:Dot(upRef)).Unit
			local vX = vY:Cross(vZ)
			return CFrame.fromMatrix(position, vX, vY, vZ)
		end

		local function closestPointOnSegment(A, B, P)
			local ab = B - A
			local abLen2 = ab:Dot(ab)
			if abLen2 < 1e-6 then
				return (P - A).Magnitude, A
			end
			local t = (P - A):Dot(ab) / abLen2
			t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
			local closest = A + ab * t
			return (P - closest).Magnitude, closest
		end

		local function findClickTarget()
			local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not camera then
				return { staticPosition = Humanoid and Humanoid.TargetPoint or Vector3.new() }
			end

			local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouseLocation.X, mouseLocation.Y)

			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			local excludeList = {}
			if Handle then table.insert(excludeList, Handle) end
			if ActiveShot then table.insert(excludeList, ActiveShot) end
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excludeList

			local result = Workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * MAX_CLICK_RANGE, params)

			if not result then
				local fallback = Humanoid and Humanoid.TargetPoint or (ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 100)
				return { staticPosition = fallback }
			end

			local hitPart = result.Instance

			local currentModel = hitPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			while currentModel do
				local modelHumanoid = currentModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local rootPart = currentModel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					or (modelHumanoid and modelHumanoid.RootPart)
					or (modelHumanoid and modelHumanoid.Torso)

				if modelHumanoid or rootPart then
					return {
						npc            = currentModel,
						humanoid       = modelHumanoid,
						rootPart       = rootPart or hitPart,
						hitPosition    = result.Position,
						staticPosition = result.Position,
					}
				end

				currentModel = currentModel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			end

			return {
				staticPosition = result.Position,
				hitPart        = hitPart,
			}
		end

		local function shouldDodgeObstacle(hitPart)
			local node = hitPart
			local topModel = nil
			for _ = 1, 6 do
				if not node or node == Workspace then break end
				if node:IsA("Model") then
					if node:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						return false
					end
					topModel = node
				end
				node = node.Parent
			end

			local size
			if topModel then
				local ok, bbox = pcall(function()
					return topModel:GetExtentsSize()
				end)
				if ok and bbox then
					size = bbox
				end
			end
			if not size then
				size = hitPart.Size
			end

			local axes = {size.X, size.Y, size.Z}
			table.sort(axes)
			if axes[1] < 3 and axes[2] < 3 then
				return false
			end

			return true
		end

		local function findAvoidanceDir(origin, desiredDir, params, maxLen)
			local lookLen = math.min(ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD, maxLen or ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD)

			local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, desiredDir * lookLen, params)
			if not hit then return nil, 0 end

			if not shouldDodgeObstacle(hit.Instance) then
				return nil, 0
			end

			local hitDist = (hit.Position - origin).Magnitude
			local strength = math.clamp(1 - (hitDist / lookLen), 0, 1)
			strength = strength ^ ROCKET_AVOID_RAMP_EXP

			local up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			if math.abs(desiredDir:Dot(up)) > 0.95 then
				up = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end
			local right = desiredDir:Cross(up).Unit
			local left = -right
			local down = -up

			local candidates = {
				right, left,
				(right + up).Unit,   (left + up).Unit,
				(right + down).Unit, (left + down).Unit,
				up, down,
			}
			local bestDir, bestScore = nil, -math.huge

			for _, side in ipairs(candidates) do
				local candidate = (desiredDir + side * ROCKET_OBSTACLE_AVOID_PULL).Unit
				local test = Workspace:Raycast(origin, candidate * lookLen, params)
				local clearance
				if test then
					clearance = (test.Position - origin).Magnitude
				else
					clearance = lookLen
				end
				local score = clearance + candidate:Dot(desiredDir) * 6
				if candidate.Y < -0.3 then
					score = score - 8
				end
				if score > bestScore then
					bestScore, bestDir = score, candidate
				end
			end

			return bestDir, strength
		end

		local function OnActivated()
			if Tool.Enabled and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				Tool.Enabled = false

				cleanupActive()

				local handleCFrame = Handle.CFrame
				local firingPoint = handleCFrame:PointToWorldSpace(MUZZLE_LOCAL_OFFSET)

				local clickTarget = findClickTarget()

				local initialTargetPos
				if clickTarget.npc and clickTarget.rootPart and clickTarget.rootPart.Parent then
					initialTargetPos = clickTarget.rootPart.Position
				else
					initialTargetPos = clickTarget.staticPosition
				end

				local aimVec = initialTargetPos - firingPoint
				if aimVec.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
					aimVec = handleCFrame.lookVector * 100
					initialTargetPos = firingPoint + aimVec
				end

				local targetDistance = (initialTargetPos - firingPoint).Magnitude

				local arcAmount = 0
				if targetDistance > ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST then
					local t = math.clamp(
						(targetDistance - ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST) /
						(ROCKET_ARC_FULL_DIST - ROCKET_ARC_MIN_DIST),
						0, 1)
					arcAmount = ROCKET_INITIAL_ARC * t
				end

				local initialForward = (aimVec.Unit + Vector3.new(0, arcAmount, 0)).Unit

				local shot = BaseShot:Clone()
				local initialCF = nozzleCFrame(firingPoint + initialForward * ROCKET_FORWARD_OFFSET, initialForward)
				shot.CFrame = initialCF
				ActiveShot = shot

				if clickTarget.npc then
					shotTargets[shot] = clickTarget.npc
				end
				task.delay(ROCKET_ARM_TIME, function()
					if shot and shot.Parent then
						shot:SetAttribute("Armed", true)
					end
				end)

				local isSelfTarget = (clickTarget.npc ~= nil and clickTarget.npc == Character)
				if isSelfTarget then
					shot:SetAttribute("AllowSelfHit", true)
				end

				local targetPart = nil
				if clickTarget.npc and clickTarget.rootPart and clickTarget.rootPart.Parent then
					targetPart = clickTarget.rootPart
				end

				local whoosh = Instance.new("Sound")
				whoosh.Name = "RocketWhoosh"
				whoosh.SoundId = "rbxasset://sounds/Rocket whoosh 01.wav"
				whoosh.Looped = true
				whoosh.Volume = WHOOSH_START_VOLUME
				whoosh.Parent = SoundService
				ActiveWhoosh = whoosh

				local gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
				gyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
				gyro.P = ROCKET_STEER_P
				gyro.D = ROCKET_STEER_D
				gyro.CFrame = initialCF
				gyro.Parent = shot

				local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
				bodyVelocity.Velocity = initialForward * SHOT_SPEED
				bodyVelocity.Parent = shot

				local lastPos = shot.Position
				local committedAvoidDir, committedAvoidUntil = nil, 0
				local terminalLock = false

				local ignoreList = {shot, Handle}
				if Character then table.insert(ignoreList, Character) end
				if clickTarget.npc then table.insert(ignoreList, clickTarget.npc) end

				local avoidParams = RaycastParams.new()
				avoidParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				avoidParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
				avoidParams.IgnoreWater = true

				local updateConn
				updateConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					if not shot or not shot.Parent then
						if updateConn then updateConn:Disconnect() end
						return
					end

					local liveTargetPos
					if targetPart and targetPart.Parent then
						liveTargetPos = targetPart.Position
					else
						liveTargetPos = clickTarget.staticPosition
					end

					local currentPos = shot.Position
					local distToTarget = (liveTargetPos - currentPos).Magnitude

					local closestDist, closestPt = closestPointOnSegment(lastPos, currentPos, liveTargetPos)
					if closestDist <= ROCKET_DETONATE_DIST then
						OnTouched(shot, nil, closestPt)
						return
					end

					if not terminalLock and distToTarget <= ROCKET_TERMINAL_LOCK_DIST then
						terminalLock = true
					end

					if terminalLock then
						local lockVec = liveTargetPos - currentPos
						if lockVec.Magnitude > 0.01 then
							local dir = lockVec.Unit

							local forwardDot = dir:Dot(shot.CFrame.LookVector)
							if forwardDot < -0.5 and distToTarget < ROCKET_OVERSHOOT_DIST then
								OnTouched(shot, nil, currentPos)
								return
							end

							gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentPos, currentPos + dir)
							bodyVelocity.Velocity = dir * SHOT_SPEED
						else
							OnTouched(shot, nil, currentPos)
							return
						end
					else
						local steerTargetPos = liveTargetPos
						local toTargetSteer = steerTargetPos - currentPos
						local finalDir = shot.CFrame.LookVector

						if toTargetSteer.Magnitude > 0.5 then
							local desiredDir = toTargetSteer.Unit
							finalDir = desiredDir

							local probeLen = math.min(
								ROCKET_OBSTACLE_LOOKAHEAD,
								math.max(0, distToTarget - 4))

							if probeLen >= 5 then
								local blend = 0

								if committedAvoidDir and os.clock() < committedAvoidUntil then
									local probe = Workspace:Raycast(
										currentPos,
										desiredDir * probeLen,
										avoidParams)
									if probe and shouldDodgeObstacle(probe.Instance) then
										local d = (probe.Position - currentPos).Magnitude
										local s = math.clamp(1 - (d / probeLen), 0, 1)
										blend = ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND * (s ^ ROCKET_AVOID_RAMP_EXP)
									elseif probe then
										committedAvoidDir = nil
										blend = 0
									else
										blend = ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND
									end
									if blend > 0 then
										finalDir = (desiredDir * (1 - blend)
											+ committedAvoidDir * blend).Unit
									end
								else
									local avoidDir, avoidStrength =
										findAvoidanceDir(currentPos, desiredDir, avoidParams, probeLen)
									if avoidDir then
										committedAvoidDir = avoidDir
										committedAvoidUntil = os.clock() + ROCKET_AVOID_STICKY_TIME
										blend = ROCKET_AVOID_BLEND * avoidStrength
										finalDir = (desiredDir * (1 - blend)
											+ avoidDir * blend).Unit
									else
										committedAvoidDir = nil
									end
								end
							else
								committedAvoidDir = nil
							end

							gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentPos, currentPos + finalDir)
						end

						local speed = SHOT_SPEED
						if distToTarget < ROCKET_SLOWDOWN_DIST then
							local t = distToTarget / ROCKET_SLOWDOWN_DIST
							speed = SHOT_SPEED * math.max(ROCKET_MIN_SPEED_FRACTION, t)
						end

						local curForward = shot.CFrame.LookVector
						local alignment = math.clamp(curForward:Dot(finalDir), 0, 1)
						local cornerFactor = ROCKET_CORNER_MIN_SPEED
							+ (1 - ROCKET_CORNER_MIN_SPEED) * alignment
						speed = speed * cornerFactor

						bodyVelocity.Velocity = curForward * speed
					end

					lastPos = currentPos

					if whoosh and whoosh.Parent then
						local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
						if cam then
							local dist = (currentPos - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
							local alpha
							if dist <= WHOOSH_FADE_START then
								alpha = 1
							elseif dist >= WHOOSH_FADE_END then
								alpha = 0
							else
								alpha = 1 - ((dist - WHOOSH_FADE_START) / (WHOOSH_FADE_END - WHOOSH_FADE_START))
							end
							whoosh.Volume = WHOOSH_START_VOLUME * alpha
							if alpha <= 0 then
								whoosh:Stop()
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				ActiveUpdateConn = updateConn

				shot.Destroying:Connect(function()
					if updateConn then updateConn:Disconnect() end
					if ActiveUpdateConn == updateConn then ActiveUpdateConn = nil end
					if whoosh then
						whoosh:Stop()
						whoosh:Destroy()
						if ActiveWhoosh == whoosh then ActiveWhoosh = nil end
					end
				end)

				whoosh:Play()

				shot.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
					OnTouched(shot, otherPart)
				end)
				DebrisService:AddItem(shot, SHOT_TIME)
				shot.Parent = Tool

				task.delay(SHOT_TIME + 0.1, function()
					if ActiveShot == shot then
						cleanupActive()
					end
				end)

				wait(0)
				ReloadSound:Play()
				wait(2)
				Tool.Enabled = true
			end
		end

		BaseShot = Instance.new('Part')
		BaseShot.Name = 'Rocket'
		BaseShot.FormFactor = Enum.FormFactor.Custom
		BaseShot.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
		BaseShot.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
		BaseShot.CanCollide = false
		BaseShot.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(ROCKET_COLOR)
		BaseShot.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
		BaseShot.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		BaseShot.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth

		local rocketMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
		rocketMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
		rocketMesh.MeshId = ROCKET_MESH_ID
		rocketMesh.Scale = ROCKET_MESH_SCALE
		rocketMesh.Parent = BaseShot

		local rocketFire = Instance.new("Fire")
		rocketFire.Heat = ROCKET_FIRE_HEAT
		rocketFire.Size = ROCKET_FIRE_SIZE
		rocketFire.Parent = BaseShot

		Tool.Equipped:Connect(OnEquipped)
		Tool.Activated:Connect(OnActivated)
	end, ToolScript)
end))
